title: 盾尾空隙同步灌漿~Synchronous tail-void grouting
focus: 以環隙體積、漿體時變行為與環片浮力驗證盾尾背填~Verify tail-void backfill through annular volume, time-dependent grout and lining buoyancy
summary: 本課聚焦以環隙體積、漿體時變行為與環片浮力驗證盾尾背填。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on verify tail-void backfill through annular volume, time-dependent grout and lining buoyancy. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 理論環隙與超挖~Theoretical annulus and overbreak
units.title: 理論環隙與超挖~Theoretical annulus and overbreak
units.mechanism: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。超挖、地層變形與盾體姿態使實際空隙不同，不能用單一名義體積推定填充已完整。 假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。~Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. A circular annular volume is only a reference, since overbreak, ground deformation and shield attitude change the actual space; nominal volume alone does not prove complete filling. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³.
units.verify: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。~Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.
units.failure: 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。~Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.
units.misconception: 注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。~Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄理論環隙與超挖的資料來源與適用條件。核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for theoretical annulus and overbreak. Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.

units.anchor: 輸送收支與有效填充~Delivery balance and effective filling
units.title: 輸送收支與有效填充~Delivery balance and effective filling
units.mechanism: 泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。每環收支需追蹤時間延遲，否則計量器在本環記錄的材料可能到下一環才排出。 假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。~Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there. Ring accounting needs transport delay because volume registered in one ring may arrive during the next. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved.
units.verify: 以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。~Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining.
units.failure: 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。~Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining.
units.misconception: 泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。~The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄輸送收支與有效填充的資料來源與適用條件。以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for delivery balance and effective filling. Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill.

units.anchor: 高程壓差與傳遞~Elevation pressure and transmission
units.title: 高程壓差與傳遞~Elevation pressure and transmission
units.mechanism: 漿體自重使不同高程注入口壓力不同，管線損失又使泵端壓力高於環隙。環片和地層實際承受的是局部外壓，必須以相同高程及量測位置比較，避免將泵壓直接套到結構。 假設漿密度1800 kg/m³、高差6 m，靜壓差ρgΔz=105.95 kPa；流動時另有管損。 把低處壓力當頂部壓力會高估頂部填充或錯估結構載重，堵塞管線又可形成高壓假象；若只記單一泵表，難以定位問題所在。~Grout weight changes pressure with elevation while line loss separates pump and annulus readings. Ground and lining respond to local pressure, requiring common elevation and sensor-location references rather than direct use of pump pressure as structural loading. Assume grout density 1800 kg/m³ and elevation difference 6 m; static difference ρgΔz=105.95 kPa, with additional losses during flow. Using a low-level reading for the crown overstates filling pressure or misstates loading, and blockage creates a high-pressure illusion. One pump gauge alone cannot localize the discrepancy in the delivery system.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設漿密度1800 kg/m³、高差6 m，靜壓差ρgΔz=105.95 kPa；流動時另有管損。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume grout density 1800 kg/m³ and elevation difference 6 m; static difference ρgΔz=105.95 kPa, with additional losses during flow.
units.verify: 核對各壓力計與注入口高程、零點及流量，將靜態與流動讀值分開；分析者需辨識高泵壓低流量的堵塞可能，所有控制界線由工程核准，算例不提供注漿壓力指令。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把低處壓力當頂部壓力會高估頂部填充或錯估結構載重，堵塞管線又可形成高壓假象；若只記單一泵表，難以定位問題所在。~Check sensor and port elevations, zero and flow, separating static from flowing readings; analysts investigate blockage when high pump pressure accompanies low delivery, with limits approved by engineers rather than supplied by this example. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using a low-level reading for the crown overstates filling pressure or misstates loading, and blockage creates a high-pressure illusion. One pump gauge alone cannot localize the discrepancy in the delivery system.
units.failure: 把低處壓力當頂部壓力會高估頂部填充或錯估結構載重，堵塞管線又可形成高壓假象；若只記單一泵表，難以定位問題所在。~Using a low-level reading for the crown overstates filling pressure or misstates loading, and blockage creates a high-pressure illusion. One pump gauge alone cannot localize the discrepancy in the delivery system.
units.misconception: 泵端壓力可以不修正高程與管損直接當環片外壓。~Pump-end pressure directly equals lining pressure without elevation or line-loss correction.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄高程壓差與傳遞的資料來源與適用條件。核對各壓力計與注入口高程、零點及流量，將靜態與流動讀值分開；分析者需辨識高泵壓低流量的堵塞可能，所有控制界線由工程核准，算例不提供注漿壓力指令。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for elevation pressure and transmission. Check sensor and port elevations, zero and flow, separating static from flowing readings; analysts investigate blockage when high pump pressure accompanies low delivery, with limits approved by engineers rather than supplied by this example.

units.anchor: 流變與泌水分離~Rheology and bleed separation
units.title: 流變與泌水分離~Rheology and bleed separation
units.mechanism: 漿體需流入狹窄環隙又保持均勻，屈服阻力過高限制擴散，泌水則使初始體積在硬化前縮小。流動度、泌水及凝結時間必須一起評估，不能用最容易泵送作唯一品質目標。 假設1 L試樣析水30 mL，泌水比例3%；不等於現地空隙必定增加3%。 高流動性可能伴隨大量泌水而在頂部留下空隙，過度增稠又可能只充滿注入口附近；單一流動度合格無法排除這兩種相反失效。~Grout must enter narrow voids while remaining uniform. Excess yield resistance limits spread, whereas bleeding reduces effective volume before hardening. Flow, bleed and set time require joint assessment rather than easiest pumping as the sole quality target. If an assumed 1 L sample releases 30 mL water, bleed is 3%; this does not mean the field void necessarily increases by 3%. High flowability may come with bleeding that leaves crown voids, while thick grout fills only near ports. Passing one flow test cannot exclude either of these opposing failure mechanisms in practice.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設1 L試樣析水30 mL，泌水比例3%；不等於現地空隙必定增加3%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 1 L sample releases 30 mL water, bleed is 3%; this does not mean the field void necessarily increases by 3%.
units.verify: 按核准方法同時試驗流動性、泌水和時間變化，保留溫度、材料批次與混合歷程；灌漿工程師需核對試樣和現場剪切環境，將未驗證尺度轉換列為限制。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：高流動性可能伴隨大量泌水而在頂部留下空隙，過度增稠又可能只充滿注入口附近；單一流動度合格無法排除這兩種相反失效。~Test flow, bleed and time dependence using approved methods with temperature, batches and mixing history; grout engineers compare specimen and field shear conditions and identify unverified scale transfer explicitly. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: High flowability may come with bleeding that leaves crown voids, while thick grout fills only near ports. Passing one flow test cannot exclude either of these opposing failure mechanisms in practice.
units.failure: 高流動性可能伴隨大量泌水而在頂部留下空隙，過度增稠又可能只充滿注入口附近；單一流動度合格無法排除這兩種相反失效。~High flowability may come with bleeding that leaves crown voids, while thick grout fills only near ports. Passing one flow test cannot exclude either of these opposing failure mechanisms in practice.
units.misconception: 流動度合格就可以不再檢查漿體泌水或材料分離。~Passing a flow test removes any need to inspect bleeding or segregation.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄流變與泌水分離的資料來源與適用條件。按核准方法同時試驗流動性、泌水和時間變化，保留溫度、材料批次與混合歷程；灌漿工程師需核對試樣和現場剪切環境，將未驗證尺度轉換列為限制。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rheology and bleed separation. Test flow, bleed and time dependence using approved methods with temperature, batches and mixing history; grout engineers compare specimen and field shear conditions and identify unverified scale transfer explicitly.

units.anchor: 凝結時間與輸送延遲~Setting time and delivery delay
units.title: 凝結時間與輸送延遲~Setting time and delivery delay
units.mechanism: 材料從混合到到達環隙經歷管路停留與剪切，凝結或增稠會改變可用流動時間。時間估算需包括停機和死區，平均停留短並不保證所有材料都未老化，尤其多組分系統更需明確控制體。 假設有效管容0.12 m³、流量0.004 m³/s，名義停留30 s；不含停機和非理想混合。 只看平均停留會漏掉死區已凝材料，壓降逐漸增加可能被誤認為環隙已滿；在錯誤判讀下減少填充，會把堵塞問題轉成背填空洞。~Mixed material ages and shears during transport, changing its workable time. Include stoppages and dead zones: a short mean residence does not guarantee fresh material everywhere, especially in multicomponent systems with distinct mixing locations. Assume effective line volume 0.12 m³ and flow 0.004 m³/s; nominal residence is 30 s, excluding stoppages and nonideal mixing. Mean residence misses hardened material in dead zones, and rising loss may be mistaken for a full annulus. Reducing delivery on that interpretation turns a line blockage into an unfilled support void.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效管容0.12 m³、流量0.004 m³/s，名義停留30 s；不含停機和非理想混合。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective line volume 0.12 m³ and flow 0.004 m³/s; nominal residence is 30 s, excluding stoppages and nonideal mixing.
units.verify: 將混合位置、管線容積、流量及材料時間試驗對齊，檢查停機重啟是否產生老化團塊；設備和材料負責人共同核准方案，本課不提供促凝比例或管路處理操作。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只看平均停留會漏掉死區已凝材料，壓降逐漸增加可能被誤認為環隙已滿；在錯誤判讀下減少填充，會把堵塞問題轉成背填空洞。~Align mixing location, volume and flow with time-dependent material tests and inspect restart evidence for aged lumps; equipment and materials leads approve the scheme, with no accelerator ratio or line-treatment procedure prescribed here. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mean residence misses hardened material in dead zones, and rising loss may be mistaken for a full annulus. Reducing delivery on that interpretation turns a line blockage into an unfilled support void.
units.failure: 只看平均停留會漏掉死區已凝材料，壓降逐漸增加可能被誤認為環隙已滿；在錯誤判讀下減少填充，會把堵塞問題轉成背填空洞。~Mean residence misses hardened material in dead zones, and rising loss may be mistaken for a full annulus. Reducing delivery on that interpretation turns a line blockage into an unfilled support void.
units.misconception: 平均管線停留短就保證所有死區材料都尚未老化。~A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄凝結時間與輸送延遲的資料來源與適用條件。將混合位置、管線容積、流量及材料時間試驗對齊，檢查停機重啟是否產生老化團塊；設備和材料負責人共同核准方案，本課不提供促凝比例或管路處理操作。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for setting time and delivery delay. Align mixing location, volume and flow with time-dependent material tests and inspect restart evidence for aged lumps; equipment and materials leads approve the scheme, with no accelerator ratio or line-treatment procedure prescribed here.

units.anchor: 環片浮力與抬升~Lining buoyancy and uplift
units.title: 環片浮力與抬升~Lining buoyancy and uplift
units.mechanism: 新鮮漿體對環片產生浮力，未形成硬化支承前的環片重量、連接與約束共同抵抗抬升。局部非均勻壓力還會造成轉動，不能只用總注入量推定環片位置穩定。 假設外壓近似靜水分布，有效排開漿體體積15 m³（非混凝土體積）、密度1200 kg/m³，浮力176.58 kN；環重12 t為117.72 kN，未計約束淨上力58.86 kN。 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。~Fresh grout creates buoyancy resisted by lining weight, connections and restraints before hard support forms. Uneven local pressures also cause rotation, so total delivery cannot establish positional stability of the ring. Assume near-hydrostatic external pressure and effective displaced grout volume of 15 m³, not concrete volume, at 1200 kg/m³; buoyancy is 176.58 kN. A 12 t ring weighs 117.72 kN, leaving 58.86 kN before restraints. Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設外壓近似靜水分布，有效排開漿體體積15 m³（非混凝土體積）、密度1200 kg/m³，浮力176.58 kN；環重12 t為117.72 kN，未計約束淨上力58.86 kN。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume near-hydrostatic external pressure and effective displaced grout volume of 15 m³, not concrete volume, at 1200 kg/m³; buoyancy is 176.58 kN. A 12 t ring weighs 117.72 kN, leaving 58.86 kN before restraints.
units.verify: 同步環片高程、姿態與注入分區時序，核對新鮮漿體密度及支承形成時間；結構工程師需評估接縫與臨時約束路徑，不能把淨上力直接變成未核准的固定或加載措施。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。~Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time; structural engineers assess joint and temporary restraint paths rather than converting net uplift into an unapproved fixing or loading measure. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance.
units.failure: 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。~Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance.
units.misconception: 計算環片浮力時應使用混凝土材料體積作排開漿體體積。~Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄環片浮力與抬升的資料來源與適用條件。同步環片高程、姿態與注入分區時序，核對新鮮漿體密度及支承形成時間；結構工程師需評估接縫與臨時約束路徑，不能把淨上力直接變成未核准的固定或加載措施。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for lining buoyancy and uplift. Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time; structural engineers assess joint and temporary restraint paths rather than converting net uplift into an unapproved fixing or loading measure.

units.anchor: 早齡剛度與荷載接替~Early stiffness and load transfer
units.title: 早齡剛度與荷載接替~Early stiffness and load transfer
units.mechanism: 背填從流體逐漸變成可傳遞剪力與壓縮的固體，這段轉換控制地層和襯砌何時互相支承。早期抗壓強度與剛度不是同一性質，支承模型需使用相應時間的材料狀態。 假設等效壓縮模數50 MPa、應變0.001，線彈性示意應力0.05 MPa=50 kPa；不代表破壞強度。 以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。~Backfill changes from fluid to a solid carrying compression and shear, governing when ground and lining support one another. Early compressive strength differs from stiffness, so support models must use the material state at the relevant age. Assume compression modulus 50 MPa and strain 0.001; illustrative elastic stress is 0.05 MPa=50 kPa, not failure strength. Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments. The same material therefore needs time-dependent characterization rather than one constant.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等效壓縮模數50 MPa、應變0.001，線彈性示意應力0.05 MPa=50 kPa；不代表破壞強度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume compression modulus 50 MPa and strain 0.001; illustrative elastic stress is 0.05 MPa=50 kPa, not failure strength.
units.verify: 以代表齡期試驗取得強度和變形資料，對照盾尾通過、灌漿與地層變形時間；模型需分列未凝、過渡和硬化狀態，不能只用最終試體結果推回剛完成一環的支承。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。~Test strength and deformation at representative ages and align tail passage, injection and ground movement; distinguish fluid, transitional and hardened states instead of projecting final specimen performance back to a newly completed ring. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments. The same material therefore needs time-dependent characterization rather than one constant.
units.failure: 以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。~Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments. The same material therefore needs time-dependent characterization rather than one constant.
units.misconception: 最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。~Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄早齡剛度與荷載接替的資料來源與適用條件。以代表齡期試驗取得強度和變形資料，對照盾尾通過、灌漿與地層變形時間；模型需分列未凝、過渡和硬化狀態，不能只用最終試體結果推回剛完成一環的支承。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for early stiffness and load transfer. Test strength and deformation at representative ages and align tail passage, injection and ground movement; distinguish fluid, transitional and hardened states instead of projecting final specimen performance back to a newly completed ring.

units.anchor: 收縮與失水容積~Shrinkage and volume loss
units.title: 收縮與失水容積~Shrinkage and volume loss
units.mechanism: 泌水、化學收縮與地層吸水會改變背填硬化後容積，各機制發生時間和位置不同。試樣自由收縮不等於現場受約束空洞，但可提示需要核對密實度與長期接觸，不能只看初期注滿。 假設初始填充3 m³、自由體積縮減2%，變化0.06 m³；現地是否成空洞取決於補給與約束。 地層吸水可能使注入口附近迅速增稠而遠端未填，後期收縮又加大接觸缺口；若只在早期量一次漿體強度，便看不到這些容積機制。~Bleeding, chemical shrinkage and ground absorption alter hardened volume at different times and locations. Free specimen shrinkage is not directly a restrained field void, but signals a need to examine density and lasting contact beyond initial filling. Assume initial fill 3 m³ and free volumetric reduction 2%; change is 0.06 m³, with field void formation dependent on replenishment and restraint. Ground absorption can thicken grout near ports before distant voids fill, and later shrinkage enlarges contact gaps. A single early strength measurement does not reveal either of these volume-related processes.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設初始填充3 m³、自由體積縮減2%，變化0.06 m³；現地是否成空洞取決於補給與約束。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume initial fill 3 m³ and free volumetric reduction 2%; change is 0.06 m³, with field void formation dependent on replenishment and restraint.
units.verify: 量測材料體積穩定性、泌水與吸水情境，對照現地壓力和後期檢查；灌漿及地工工程師需區分材料本身縮減和外部流失，不把自由試樣百分比直接當空洞率。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：地層吸水可能使注入口附近迅速增稠而遠端未填，後期收縮又加大接觸缺口；若只在早期量一次漿體強度，便看不到這些容積機制。~Measure volume stability, bleeding and absorption scenarios against field pressure and later inspections; grout and geotechnical engineers distinguish material reduction from external loss rather than equating free-sample percentage with field void ratio. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ground absorption can thicken grout near ports before distant voids fill, and later shrinkage enlarges contact gaps. A single early strength measurement does not reveal either of these volume-related processes.
units.failure: 地層吸水可能使注入口附近迅速增稠而遠端未填，後期收縮又加大接觸缺口；若只在早期量一次漿體強度，便看不到這些容積機制。~Ground absorption can thicken grout near ports before distant voids fill, and later shrinkage enlarges contact gaps. A single early strength measurement does not reveal either of these volume-related processes.
units.misconception: 自由試樣收縮百分比必定等於現場環隙的空洞率。~Free specimen shrinkage percentage necessarily equals field annular void ratio.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄收縮與失水容積的資料來源與適用條件。量測材料體積穩定性、泌水與吸水情境，對照現地壓力和後期檢查；灌漿及地工工程師需區分材料本身縮減和外部流失，不把自由試樣百分比直接當空洞率。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for shrinkage and volume loss. Measure volume stability, bleeding and absorption scenarios against field pressure and later inspections; grout and geotechnical engineers distinguish material reduction from external loss rather than equating free-sample percentage with field void ratio.

units.anchor: 空洞檢測與非唯一性~Void detection and nonuniqueness
units.title: 空洞檢測與非唯一性~Void detection and nonuniqueness
units.mechanism: 襯砌背後缺陷可由聲學、雷達或其他核准方法提供線索，但反射異常也可能來自含水、材料界面或鋼筋。檢測須校準到現場構造並有獨立查證，不能把色圖每個異常直接當空洞。 假設100 m²檢查面中10 m²無有效資料，可評估覆蓋90%；未量區不能併入無缺陷面積。 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。~Approved acoustic, radar or other methods can indicate defects behind lining, but reflections also arise from water, interfaces and steel. Calibrate to actual construction and verify independently rather than labeling every colored anomaly a void. If an assumed 100 m² inspection area includes 10 m² without valid data, coverage is 90%; unmeasured areas cannot count as defect-free. Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m²檢查面中10 m²無有效資料，可評估覆蓋90%；未量區不能併入無缺陷面積。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 100 m² inspection area includes 10 m² without valid data, coverage is 90%; unmeasured areas cannot count as defect-free.
units.verify: 用已知構造或代表試件評估檢測辨識能力，將異常與注入量、壓力及沉陷交叉比對；確認範圍由工程師指定合適方法，任何鑽查需另有核准，課程不提供現場穿孔步驟。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。~Assess detection on known construction or representative specimens and compare anomalies with quantities, pressures and movement; engineers select confirmation methods, with any intrusive investigation separately approved rather than instructed by this course. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling.
units.failure: 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。~Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling.
units.misconception: 非破壞檢測圖上的每一個反射異常都必定是空洞。~Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄空洞檢測與非唯一性的資料來源與適用條件。用已知構造或代表試件評估檢測辨識能力，將異常與注入量、壓力及沉陷交叉比對；確認範圍由工程師指定合適方法，任何鑽查需另有核准，課程不提供現場穿孔步驟。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for void detection and nonuniqueness. Assess detection on known construction or representative specimens and compare anomalies with quantities, pressures and movement; engineers select confirmation methods, with any intrusive investigation separately approved rather than instructed by this course.

units.anchor: 背填證據工程移交~Backfill evidence and handover
units.title: 背填證據工程移交~Backfill evidence and handover
units.mechanism: 背填品質是體積、材料、壓力和幾何的一致證據，不是單一到量記錄。交接應把每環分區資料與環片位置、地層和檢測相連，讓後續發現滲漏或沉陷時可追查原始成因。 假設10環中8環收支閉合且證據完整，覆蓋80%；其餘2環要逐環列出缺項與審查決定。 只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。~Backfill quality requires consistent volume, material, pressure and geometry evidence rather than one delivered-quantity record. Link each ring and zone to lining location, geology and inspection so later leakage or settlement remains diagnosable. If 8 of an assumed 10 rings have closed balances and complete evidence, coverage is 80%; the other 2 require individual gaps and review decisions. Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10環中8環收支閉合且證據完整，覆蓋80%；其餘2環要逐環列出缺項與審查決定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 rings have closed balances and complete evidence, coverage is 80%; the other 2 require individual gaps and review decisions.
units.verify: 抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。~Trace a ring through batches, pumping, ports, pose and later inspection with consistent clocks and versions; grout, structural and geotechnical leads accept limitations explicitly instead of substituting an average fill ratio for individual anomaly resolution. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems.
units.failure: 只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。~Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems.
units.misconception: 整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。~A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄背填證據工程移交的資料來源與適用條件。抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for backfill evidence and handover. Trace a ring through batches, pumping, ports, pose and later inspection with consistent clocks and versions; grout, structural and geotechnical leads accept limitations explicitly instead of substituting an average fill ratio for individual anomaly resolution.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以環隙體積、漿體時變行為與環片浮力驗證盾尾背填需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why verify tail-void backfill through annular volume, time-dependent grout and lining buoyancy requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³.

教學量化備忘：假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved.

教學量化備忘：假設漿密度1800 kg/m³、高差6 m，靜壓差ρgΔz=105.95 kPa；流動時另有管損。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume grout density 1800 kg/m³ and elevation difference 6 m; static difference ρgΔz=105.95 kPa, with additional losses during flow.
教學量化備忘：假設1 L試樣析水30 mL，泌水比例3%；不等於現地空隙必定增加3%。~Teaching quantitative note: If an assumed 1 L sample releases 30 mL water, bleed is 3%; this does not mean the field void necessarily increases by 3%.

教學量化備忘：假設有效管容0.12 m³、流量0.004 m³/s，名義停留30 s；不含停機和非理想混合。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume effective line volume 0.12 m³ and flow 0.004 m³/s; nominal residence is 30 s, excluding stoppages and nonideal mixing.

教學量化備忘：假設外壓近似靜水分布，有效排開漿體體積15 m³（非混凝土體積）、密度1200 kg/m³，浮力176.58 kN；環重12 t為117.72 kN，未計約束淨上力58.86 kN。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume near-hydrostatic external pressure and effective displaced grout volume of 15 m³, not concrete volume, at 1200 kg/m³; buoyancy is 176.58 kN. A 12 t ring weighs 117.72 kN, leaving 58.86 kN before restraints.
